ActorTalk: Ugh, these drones are impossible to control! You hanging in there, Lylian?
Mine are stable... for now. I think.
We don't have much time left. We can't let everyone down!
Well, well. If it isn't Ms. Top Student. Care to explain yourself?
Ah! Vanessa! A-and... Chief! Lucia, too! What a surprise!
That's true, but... I could never hold a candle to a Chief of your caliber!
Ah, yes!
You still haven't answered my question. What is all this?
We're preparing a performance for after the award ceremony.
With these drones?
Yes! We're programming them into light formations... Oh! Would you like to see a preview, Chief? It could be our final rehearsal!
Looks like we've got no other choice, Lylian!
Why are you suddenly so worked up...
It really was. Was that final shape the F.O.S. insignia?
Yes! You recognized it! That means all our late nights were worth it!
The launch sequence was sloppy, and the transitions lacked punch. You've had days to prepare. Is this really your best?
W-we'll use every last minute to practice! We won't disappoint!
Go back to your practice, then. Just don't make any mistake during the actual event.
Understood!
You're a Chief as well, aren't you?
Relax, Sica. It's just us.
That was impressive work.
Give them a break, Vanessa.
Actually, I have a small request. Before we go to the ceremony, Commandant, Vanessa... would you mind if we took a photo together?
To send to Lee and Liv. They couldn't attend, but they asked us to document the day. We promised them before they left.
I am not participating in your commemorative snapshot. Take your picture with just the two of you.
Sure, let's take one.
Come on, let's take it together!
Say Cheese!
